breaking.member: MainMenuScreen, PauseScreen, SettingsScreen, GameOverScreen, LoadingScreen, CreditsScreen, TitleScreen
breaking.change: The built-in screens are re-laid in the pack's parts, with separate landscape and portrait arrangements. The main menu and pause menu stand in the pack's Panel inset from the screen's edge, not as a bare list against it; their headings, notes and veils take the new Screen.heading, Screen.note, Screen.prompt and Screen.veil slots; settings and game over put their controls in one Panel; loading draws its bar with Progress. The main menu's Quit row is drawn as a danger row.
breaking.fix: A game that placed its own content against the old layout (the main menu's news card, the pause menu's side) checks it on its screens; a game that wants the former arrangement copies the screen's source into its own code.

added.summary: The game's name, set as the pack's wordmark at the head of the roll where there is no logo.
